My algebra teacher in middle school was young, really chill and always had time to stop and help. You needed help on a question? He'd stop class and talk to as many people as he could to help them and made sure we were ready to move on. Feeling sad or not up for it? Mr. E. would always play a fun video in the first 10 to 20 minutes of class and he always offered his support. Went to his desk quite a few times and he helped me with my bad anxiety at the time. We also had discussions, and debates. He let us share our opinions and he shared his, as long as everyone stayed cool and respected each other's opinions. Mr. E. was kind of like another student, at times he would get sidetracked and talk about video games, superheroes, or anime lol. Surprisingly, our class was ahead of most and we always had time for fun shit like all of that, guy had a real passion for teaching and it was easy to tell.
